items.name: Vice City
items.description: Vice City brings together beaches, shopping districts, a cruise port and Downtown’s skyscrapers. Rockstar mentions Ocean Beach, Little Cuba, Tisha-Wocka and VC Port, and makes it the densest, liveliest area in Leonida.
items.tagline: The capital of sun and excess, far from the ’80s but as hungry as ever.

items.name: Leonida Keys
items.description: A tropical archipelago linked by long roads over the water. Locals live off fishing, seaside bars and quiet smuggling: Jason lives there on a property owned by Brian Heder, whose boatyard still moves goods on the side.
items.tagline: A string of islands where people live off the sea, fishing and quiet smuggling.

items.name: Grassrivers
items.description: The country’s largest subtropical wilderness: mangroves, slow channels and flooded plains you cross by airboat. Rockstar calls it Leonida’s untamed jewel, as beautiful as it is dangerous.
items.tagline: Leonida’s wild swamps, where the alligator is the most famous attraction.

items.name: Port Gellhorn
items.description: Once a vacation destination, Port Gellhorn now lives off what’s left: cheap motels, empty malls and closed-down attractions. A place to lie low and take the jobs nobody else wants.
items.tagline: A faded beach resort of cheap motels and closed-down attractions.

items.name: Ambrosia
items.description: Leonida’s farming and industrial side, built around the Allied Crystal sugar refinery. It provides the jobs; a local biker gang provides, according to Rockstar, pretty much everything else.
items.tagline: The state’s industrial heartland, where American industry and old-school values still rule.

items.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
items.description: Northern Leonida’s national park: forests, hills, rivers and muddy trails. Rockstar presents it as a place for hunting, fishing and off-roading, far from the cities.
items.tagline: Fresh air on the northern border: hunting, fishing and off-road trails.

items.name: Jason Duval
items.description: Ex-military and raised among grifters, Jason works for the drug runners in the Keys, which is what he does best. He’d like an easy life; meeting Lucia is going to complicate everything.
items.tagline: He’d like an easy life; things just keep getting more complicated.

items.name: Lucia Caminos
items.description: Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary; fresh out, she only wants to make smart moves from now on.
items.tagline: Her father taught her to fight as soon as she could walk.

items.name: Cal Hampton
items.description: Jason’s friend and Brian’s associate, Cal feels safest at home, listening in on Coast Guard comms with a few beers and some private browser tabs open. What if everything you read on the internet was true?
items.tagline: What if everything you read on the internet was true?

items.name: Boobie Ike
items.description: A local Vice City legend, Boobie turned his years on the streets into a legit empire: real estate, the Jack of Hearts club and the Only Raw Records label, set up with Dre’Quan. All they need is a hit.
items.tagline: It’s all about heart: the Jack of Hearts.

items.name: Dre’Quan Priest
items.description: More hustler than gangster, Dre’Quan always had his sights set on music. He signed Real Dimez, partnered with Boobie in Only Raw Records and fully intends to take over the whole Vice City scene.
items.tagline: Only Raw… Records.

items.name: Real Dimez
items.description: Bae-Luxe and Roxy, friends since high school, turned their hustles into rap tracks and a nonstop online presence. Signed to Only Raw Records after a first hit, they’re hoping lightning strikes twice.
items.tagline: Viral videos, viral hooks.

items.name: Raul Bautista
items.description: A seasoned bank robber, Raul recruits partners ready to take the risks that pay off the most. His recklessness raises the stakes with every job; his crew will have to keep up or get out.
items.tagline: Experience counts.

items.name: Brian Heder
items.description: An old-school drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, Brian still moves product through his boatyard with Lori, his third wife. He puts Jason up in exchange for a few favors.
items.tagline: Nothing beats a Mudslide at sunset.

items.name: Rideout Customs
items.description: The car customization shop shown with the Ultimate Edition: custom paint, wheels and interiors, with a gold Manana on the car lift.
items.tagline: The shop where Leonida’s cars get a whole new look.
items.ultimate: Classic car customization: interiors, rims and donk style.

items.name: Sara’s Unisex Salon
items.description: The hair and nail salon shown in the official gallery, where Jason stops by for a haircut.
items.tagline: Hair and nails, for everyone.
items.ultimate: Hairstyles, Jason’s facial hair, Lucia’s makeup and nails.

items.name: Stock 305
items.description: The streetwear store named in the official gallery, with its graffiti-covered front.
items.tagline: The clothing store from the official gallery.
items.ultimate: Streetwear shop offering looks for Jason and Lucia.

items.name: Electric Fang Tattoo
items.description: The Stockyard tattoo parlor, shown with the Ultimate Edition, with its red neon wolf sign.
items.tagline: The Stockyard tattoo parlor.
items.ultimate: Tattoo parlor in Stockyard, with designs by the FAILE collective. No list of individual tattoos is published here.

items.name: One-Eyed Willie’s
items.description: The off-road build shop mentioned in the Ultimate Edition images, where a green Canis Kamacho gets rebuilt from top to bottom.
items.tagline: A named shop, not located yet.
items.ultimate: Lake Leonida shop specializing in off-road builds and hand-painted designs.

items.name: PTT YOUNGIN$
items.description: Vice City’s not-quite-legal goods store, named by Rockstar, with its decked-out dirt bike on display.
items.tagline: Not-quite-legal goods, in Vice City.

items.name: Only Raw Records
items.description: The label founded by Boobie Ike and Dre’Quan Priest, where Real Dimez is signed. All it needs is a hit.
items.tagline: The label looking for its first hit.

items.name: Jack of Hearts
items.description: Boobie Ike’s strip club, mentioned in his official profile. The club’s money funds the Only Raw Records studio.
items.tagline: Boobie’s club, at the heart of his empire.

items.name: Jason’s house in the Keys
items.description: A property owned by Brian Heder, lent to Jason rent-free. The second trailer shows him there fixing a leaky roof before heading out to collect for Brian.
items.tagline: Rent-free, but never left alone.
items.nameFr: La maison de Jason, dans les Keys

items.name: Cal Hampton’s place
items.description: Cal feels safest at home, with Coast Guard frequencies, a few beers and private browsing tabs.
items.tagline: The hideaway of a man who has read the whole internet.

items.name: Brian and Lori’s place
items.description: Brian Heder lives in the Keys with Lori, his third wife. Their boatyard is still used to move merchandise, and Lori’s sangria is waiting for Jason now and then.
items.tagline: A Leonida beach bum, with a great white shark bite.

items.name: Lucia, from prison to Vice City
items.description: Before the story begins, Lucia’s address is the Leonida Penitentiary. She gets out by luck and is after the good life her mother has dreamed of since Liberty City.
items.tagline: Freshly released, determined to only make smart moves from now on.
items.nameFr: Lucia, du pénitencier à Vice City
aliases: Lucia, from prison to Vice City

items.name: Jason’s safehouse
items.description: That’s the name Rockstar gives Jason’s house in its official gallery: a building in the Keys, lent by Brian, with his vehicles parked out front.
items.tagline: The only address Rockstar calls a safehouse.

items.name: Brian’s boatyard
items.description: Officially a boatyard in the Keys, in reality the transit point for Brian Heder’s goods since the golden age of smuggling.
items.tagline: Where the goods still come through, nice and quiet.

items.name: The motel from the first trailer
items.description: The first trailer shows Jason and Lucia in a motel room. The sign, readable in the screenshots, made it possible to place the motel on the map.
items.tagline: One room, two fugitives, a drawn curtain.
aliases: The motel from the first trailer

items.name: Vice City Style
items.description: A selection of outfits and tattoos for both protagonists. The item-by-item breakdown isn’t published.

items.name: Goodtime Gear
items.description: Clothing and accessories inspired by Macca the Gator. The item-by-item catalog is still to be documented.

items.name: Outfits and hairstyles
items.description: Pastel linen suit and retro hairstyle for Jason; red sequin mini dress and curly hair for Lucia. These descriptions aren’t made-up product names.
